finding.summary: issue["fields"]["status"]["statusCategory"]["key"] uses direct key access with no fallback; if the Jira API response omits any of these nested keys, a KeyError crashes the snapshot.
finding.fix: Use nested .get() with sensible defaults (e.g. issue.get("fields", {}).get("status", {}).get("statusCategory", {}).get("key")) and treat missing status as not done.
